text:
ella: Heads-up 11 launching benchmark narrative next week. Need X thread + LinkedIn longform + small promo clip. Can we finalize copy & hero by Mon EOD?

harry: I can sketch the X thread: 4 parts 1 hook with stat, 02 why it matters (latency vs cost), 03 quick methods note, 04 CTA to webinar + demo.

mina: Timing proposal: X live Tue 11am PT, LinkedIn Wed 10am PT, webinar Fri 9am PT. Works for ops?

ryan (ops): Works. For lead routing prefer utm_variant so we can send to AE pools. Use utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=bench_launch_jun, utm_variant=1|2. Example: https://redwood.ai/demo?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=bench_launch_jun&utm_variant=1

joy (growth): I'll create shortlinks and GA campaign. Also produce CSV mapping utm_variant -> queue_id. Example rows: 
["utm_variant,queue_id","1,AE_West","2,AE_East"]

ella: Two LinkedIn tones please: A) data-first with numbers, B) customer-first story. Keep ~120 words each.

harry: Draft X thread copy idea (variant A): 
1) "New benchmark: smart batching cut per-token cost by 55% in our tests." 
2) "We tested 5 configs across open models + quantization." 
3) "Top-line: batching strategy changes latency tradeoffs; details below." 
4) "Join our webinar Fri: https://rwd.ai/webinar?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=bench_launch_jun&utm_variant=1"

mina: For B variant switch the hook to customer angle: "How Acme Ops cut inference spend  and kept p95 latency under 200ms  register to see the approach."

ryan (ops): Routing rule: utm_variant=1 -> AE_West, utm_variant=2 -> AE_East. Also set a high-intent flag when form field "interest" == "demo" so SDRs can prioritize.

joy (growth): I'll hand over shortlinks + CSV by Tue 3pm PT.

ella: Creative asks: hero 1200x628 PNG, 1x 1080p 15s mp4 with animated chart, and a 1080x1080 carousel frame highlighting the 55% stat. Brand lockup in corner.

harry: For the clip, animate the bars and show CTA at 11s. Export H.264 1080p 30fps.

mina: Scheduler ask: can we schedule X thread as threaded post, pin first tweet for 24h, and auto-post follow-up reply at +45m with "Reminder: webinar Fri"?

ryan (ops): Yes. We can also enable an auto-reply template for mentions pointing to the webinar link. Need approved templates.

ella: Draft reply templates: 1) "Thanks! Want a quick demo? Book: <shortlink>" 2) "Join our webinar Fri for the deep dive: <shortlink>" Keep them short.

joy (growth): Also request: capture top 25 engaged handles in first 12h for outreach; we'll prioritize by company size.

harry: I'll post the LinkedIn drafts tonight in the drive for review.

ryan (ops): I'll test the webhook + routing with a staging form by Tue afternoon.

scheduler-bot: Scheduled: X thread (1748020000), LinkedIn post (1748090000).

ella: One more: two 1-liner paid copy for small promote budget: A) "Benchmark: cut per-token cost ~55% with smarter batching  watch our webinar." B) "See the test that rewrote our inference playbook  join live Fri."

mina: I'll A/B headlines and creative; report CTR by next Mon.

ella: Great. Lock by Mon EOD unless blockers. Thanks team :rocket:
